metadata.name: Decayed — Jadar end-step trigger creates Zombie token with Decayed
metadata.description: Tests the Decayed (CR 702.147a) token creation path via Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia. Turn 1: P1 casts Jadar ({1}{B}, Legendary 1/1). After both players pass priority, Jadar resolves onto P1's battlefield. P1 then passes priority through each intermediate step (BeginningOfCombat, DeclareAttackers with no attackers jumping to EndOfCombat, EndOfCombat, PostCombatMain) to reach the End step. At the beginning of P1's End step, end_step_actions() fires Jadar's AtBeginningOfYourEndStep triggered ability and places it on the stack (CR 603.1), gated by CR 603.4's intervening-if ("if you control no creatures with decayed", PB-DX3b). P1 controls no decayed creature at any point in this script, so the intervening-if is satisfied at both queue time and resolution time, and the trigger genuinely resolves: a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with Decayed enters P1's battlefield. This is the POSITIVE-path witness that the whole trigger-to-resolution pipeline (queue, intervening-if gate, resolution, CreateToken) now works end to end on a real def; the NEGATIVE path (a decayed creature already controlled suppresses the trigger) is exercised by `crates/engine/tests/primitives/pb_dx3b_stale_blocker_bucket.rs`'s T1, not by this script. See the 2026-08-01 dispute resolution below for the history of the two engine gaps this script originally documented, both now closed.
metadata.generation_notes: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia (crates/card-defs/src/defs/jadar_ghoulcaller_of_nephalia.rs): {1}{B}, Legendary Creature — Human Wizard 1/1. AbilityDefinition::Triggered { trigger_condition: TriggerCondition::AtBeginningOfYourEndStep, effect: Effect::CreateToken { spec: zombie_decayed_token_spec(1) }, intervening_if: Some(Condition::Not(Box::new(Condition::YouControlNOrMoreWithFilter { count: 1, filter: TargetFilter { has_card_type: Some(CardType::Creature), has_keywords: [KeywordAbility::Decayed] } }))) }. STATUS AS OF PB-DX3b (2026-08-01): BOTH gaps this script originally documented are closed. (1) end_step_actions() in turn_actions.rs has a generic AtBeginningOfYourEndStep carddef sweep, gated at queue time by the intervening-if (PB-DP6, then wired to the def-level Condition::Not(YouControlNOrMoreWithFilter) shape by PB-DX3b — the printed card's real gate is 'no creatures with decayed', not the stale 'no tokens named Shambling Ghast' this def's oracle_text and blocker note previously claimed). (2) The resolution-time gap this script's disputes section named ('characteristics.triggered_abilities is never populated from CardDefinition.AbilityDefinition::Triggered, so the CreateToken effect never executes') was closed separately by B14's card-registry fallback in resolution.rs's TriggeredAbility branch (see the dispute resolution below) — well before PB-DX3b, which only touched the intervening-if. This script exercises the POSITIVE path: P1 controls no decayed creature throughout, so the trigger queues, survives the resolution-time re-check (InterveningIf::CardDef, PB-DX1), and genuinely creates the Zombie token. Step advancement: from PreCombatMain with empty stack, one priority_round advances one step. The path PreCombatMain→End requires 5 priority_rounds: (1)→BeginningOfCombat, (2)→DeclareAttackers, (3) no attackers→EndOfCombat (advance_step skips blockers/damage), (4)→PostCombatMain, (5)→End. Token card name per zombie_decayed_token_spec: 'Zombie'. Mana pool: { black: 1, colorless: 1 } for {1}{B} cost.

disputes.description: REMAINING ENGINE GAP (after partial fix): The resolution path for StackObjectKind::TriggeredAbility in resolution.rs (lines ~1773-1830) looks up the trigger effect from obj.characteristics.triggered_abilities.get(ability_index). This Vec is populated by the builder from spec.triggered_abilities and keyword expansions, but NOT from AbilityDefinition::Triggered entries in CardDefinition.abilities. enrich_spec_from_def() in replay_harness.rs also does not translate AbilityDefinition::Triggered into triggered_abilities on the spec. As a result, when Jadar's end-step trigger (ability_index=0 from the CardDef sweep) resolves, triggered_abilities[0] is None, triggered_effect is None, and the CreateToken effect is never executed. The Zombie token is never created. The stack.count=1 assertion (trigger IS placed on stack by the partial fix) passes. The zones.battlefield.p1 includes Zombie assertion fails. Fix: add a card_registry fallback in the TriggeredAbility resolution branch: when characteristics.triggered_abilities.get(ability_index) is None, look up obj.card_id in the card_registry and find the Nth AbilityDefinition::Triggered entry (ability_index is the index into the subset of Triggered AbilityDefinitions). Alternatively, populate characteristics.triggered_abilities from AbilityDefinition::Triggered in enrich_spec_from_def and the builder. CR basis: CR 603.1 — triggered ability fires when event occurs; CR 608.2 — ability resolves and effect executes.

This script's final assertion checked only 'Jadar on battlefield, stack empty, life totals unchanged' and NEVER asserted the Zombie token either way -- it passed whether or not the token existed, the same vacuous-assertion shape PB-DX3's review MEDIUM found elsewhere in this campaign. Investigating why the token assertion had been dropped: the resolution-time gap the first dispute above describes (characteristics.triggered_abilities never populated from AbilityDefinition::Triggered) was ALREADY FIXED by the B14 engine fix recorded in memory/gotchas-infra.md ('resolution.rs card registry fallback for TriggeredAbility SOK') -- resolution.rs falls back to state.card_registry.get(card_id)?.abilities[ability_index] and executes the AbilityDefinition::Triggered { effect, .. } directly when the characteristics lookup misses. That fix predates PB-DX3b; this script had simply never been re-run against it. Separately, jadar_ghoulcaller_of_nephalia carried its OWN remaining gap this whole time: no CR 603.4 intervening-if at all (stale blocker note claiming a nonexistent 'no tokens named Shambling Ghast' filter, when the printed card actually says 'no creatures with decayed' -- confirmed via MCP), so the ability had never been exercised end-to-end against a real gate.
disputes.resolution: CLOSED (PB-DX3b, 2026-08-01, task scutemob-166). Fixed jadar_ghoulcaller_of_nephalia.rs: corrected the stored oracle_text (was 'no tokens named Shambling Ghast', now 'no creatures with decayed', matching MCP-verified printed text) and wired `intervening_if: Some(Condition::Not(Box::new(Condition::YouControlNOrMoreWithFilter { count: 1, filter: TargetFilter { has_card_type: Some(CardType::Creature), has_keywords: [KeywordAbility::Decayed] } })))`, gated at both queue time (rules/turn_actions.rs's AtBeginningOfYourEndStep CardDef sweep, PB-DP6) and resolution time (InterveningIf::CardDef, PB-DX1). This script's own scenario -- P1 controls no decayed creature throughout -- now genuinely satisfies the gate at both checkpoints and the CreateToken effect genuinely executes via the pre-existing B14 fallback, so the token GENUINELY appears. The final assert_state was strengthened from three facts that held vacuously either way to also assert `zones.battlefield.p1 includes Zombie`. This script remains the POSITIVE-path witness only; the negative direction (a decayed creature already controlled suppresses the trigger) is covered by crates/engine/tests/primitives/pb_dx3b_stale_blocker_bucket.rs's T1, not by this script.

resolution.note: CR 111.1, 111.5: A 2/2 black Zombie creature token with Decayed enters P1's battlefield. As of PB-DX3b (2026-08-01), both engine gaps this script originally documented are closed, and this effect genuinely executes -- see the appended dispute resolution below.
